title: Dragon Immune Blocks
description: Adds some of the End City Blocks to the Dragon Immune Tag
body:
I made this datapack orginially so I could do the builds I wanted to on the Central Island in The End without worry of the Enderdragon. Feel free to edit this to your liking or just use my preset.

### Added Blocks
- Purpur Block
- Purpur Pillar
- Purpur Slab
- Purpur Stairs
- End Rod
- End Stone Brick Slab
- End Stone Brick Stairs
- End Stone Brick Wall
- End Stone Bricks
- Magenta Stained Glass
- Ladder
